mostWorthwhile.text: Following ADH to the collecting ducts was most worthwhile: the planned picture connects receptors and added water channels to the concentration difference driving water recovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to attach nerve endings directly to the body was frustrating; the need to assemble them with pituitary vessels first was not apparent from the goal.

surprise.text: The drink led to fewer ADH signals as concentration approached its usual range, showing feedback rather than just water replacement.

arbitrary.text: The separate hormone-route assembly felt somewhat arbitrary as a construction order, even though the resulting nerve-ending-to-blood connection has a clear biological purpose.

continue.text: I would continue: the channel mechanism and the completed feedback loop made the constructions informative, despite the awkward assembly order. ADH was used without its full name or an explanation of the abbreviation, which could leave students unsure of the term.
